content.name: Experimental Shuttle Missiles
content.description: Gives the Experimental Shuttle a second missile launcher, mirrored onto the side that has none, and a missile magazine of its own. Two mounts and a magazine of 80 come to 100 missiles, against the 10 it carries in the stock game. No change to the ship model. Works on an existing savegame.
content.author: drjele
